gr-instability-criterion-a45d617b.title: GR Instability Criterion

gr-instability-criterion-a45d617b.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

effective-potential-with-angular-momentu.title: Effective Potential with Angular Momentum
effective-potential-with-angular-momentu.interpretation: The classic result of Routhian reduction in central force problems, absorbing 2D rotational kinetic energy into a 1D potential barrier.

higher-order-pole-residue-ident-ae526c43.title: Residue at a Pole of Order n
higher-order-pole-residue-ident-ae526c43.interpretation: Generalizes the residue calculation for singularities of higher order, where multiple derivatives are required to extract the dominant singular coefficient.
higher-order-pole-residue-ident-ae526c43.symmetry_origin: The nth-order singular behavior of the complex manifold near an isolated point.
higher-order-pole-residue-ident-ae526c43.limits_and_boundary: Ensures that the integral properties of analytic functions are correctly accounted for even when the singularities are non-simple.
